title: The Museum of Melted Snowmen
description: On the last snow day, the museum takes in the winter’s snowmen. By the time the spring visitors arrive, only hats, carrots, and a few smiles remain.
alt: A puddle in a museum case reflects a smiling snowman beneath a floating hat and carrot. Children in rain boots look into another case near a window full of blossoms.
pairing: An imagined last snow day × a museum of melted snowmen
